title: T1071 — Application Layer Protocol
subtitle: One beacon (a repeated check-in message from malware to its C2 server), four protocol families.

nodes.label: Sensitive data
nodes.tip: Sensitive data - What is at risk

steps.title: Initial access
steps.caption: A phishing attachment runs a small loader on FIN-WS-04, a Windows 11 workstation. The loader is small and lives in memory first. the proxy logs the first new external connection from this host in weeks - a good anchor for triage
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Allowed port, allowed look
steps.caption: The loader beacons over HTTPS on port 443 to cdn-update[.]com. The firewall passes it, because port 443 is open to everyone. HTTPS content is encrypted, so port, destination IP, timing, and size are often all you get
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Regular heartbeat
steps.caption: The beacon repeats at a fixed 60-second interval with the same byte size, because sleep and jitter (small random timing changes) are set very low. humans are random; beacons are metronomes. Periodicity plus size stability is the strongest signal
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Protocol hop
steps.caption: To reduce proxy visibility, the attacker moves tasking to DNS. The host starts TXT lookups (TXT is a DNS record type that can carry text) to sync-log[.]net. a workstation that rarely does DNS TXT lookups is a flag. Compare against the host baseline
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: Alert fires
steps.caption: A SIEM (the central log platform) periodicity rule flags same-size POST requests at 60-second intervals from one host. triage starts with two questions: is the host real, and is the destination known or new?

steps.caption: The analyst joins the proxy and DNS views. Both channels trace to the same VPS (rented virtual server) range, 203.0.113.0/24, so the host is suspected compromised. infrastructure overlap links the channels into one case instead of two weak alerts
